claim: PyTorch v2.5.1 documents algorithm nondeterminism independent of fixed random seeds; cuDNN benchmark=False alone does not ensure deterministic algorithms, and CUDA10.2+ deterministic use may require CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG.
applies_to: DLSA fixed PyTorch2.5.1 same-GPU numerical runtime
impact_on_spec: Use explicitly recorded deterministic backend on both reference and bounded implementation. No change to loss/batch125/seed/Adam/tolerance.
limitations: This diagnostic changes multiple backend controls together; it does not isolate one CUDA mechanism or prove real-batch capacity or full model training.
